title: AAT Architecten footer
description: A sparse white footer under a single light hairline: wordmark, then address, mail and phone, and socials. From 1024px they sit in five columns with a page list (the current page in ink, the rest grey) and a row of small print on the same columns; on phones they stack, with the small print spread across the bottom. Grey links darken and ink links fade to grey over 0.6s on hover.
notes: the page list is hidden on phones, as on the original (the header's menu carries it)
the columns match aat-architecten-header's: the second starts 27% into the content width
name: aat-architecten-footer
